reasoning: This is the standard automotive UI symbol for upper-body/dashboard vent airflow (a seated passenger with an arrow pointing at the chest/face), which can also be read in a to-do list as taking or choosing a passenger seat. It fits niche car HVAC tasks and travel seat selection, though many users outside a car dashboard will read it generically as a seated passenger.
